conflicts.permit: These partners may access your data and operate under their own privacy policies.
conflicts.prohibit: These partners process your data only at and according to Awesome Kids Games instructions to provide the Service, such as hosting, player support, advertising, analytics and fraud prevention.
conflicts.situation: Google AdMob, named as the main ad serving partner, processes player device identifiers to serve in-game advertising.
conflicts.reason: Advertising partners appear both among partners acting only on Awesome Kids Games instructions and among partners operating under their own policies; the policy does not say which rule governs an ad partner.

conflicts.permit: Some of the ways we market to you include email campaigns, custom audiences advertising, and “interest-based” or “personalized advertising,” including through cross-device tracking.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not track users with cross-device identifiers
conflicts.situation: Roposo delivers personalized advertising to a user by linking that user's activity across a phone and a laptop.
conflicts.reason: The marketing section lists cross-device tracking as an advertising method, while the rights section says Roposo does not track users with cross-device identifiers; the policy does not say how cross-device tracking works without them.

conflicts.permit: Analytics companies may access anonymous data (such as your IP address or device ID) to help us understand how our services are used.
conflicts.prohibit: We don't collect any personal information for analytics.
conflicts.situation: The external analytics tool used by Studio 8 Apps collects a user's device ID to measure app usage.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines personal information to include plaintext device identifiers but says analytics uses none; it does not say whether the device IDs accessed for analytics are plaintext.

conflicts.permit: This means that data you provide us or that we collect from you (including any Personal Information, as defined below), as further described in this Privacy Policy, is hosted with such third party service providers on servers that they own or control.
conflicts.prohibit: Collected data will not be shared with any other parties
conflicts.situation: Installed application usage data collected under section 4.8 is stored on servers owned by Bosco's third party hosting providers.
conflicts.reason: The policy states that all collected data is hosted by third party providers, yet says installed application usage data will not be shared with any other parties; it states no hosting exception.

conflicts.permit: All hosting is done by third party service providers that we engage.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not provide any personally identifiable information about children under 13 years of age to any third party for any purpose whatsoever.
conflicts.situation: A parent adds a child device, giving the child's name, birthdate, and phone number, which Bosco stores with its third party hosting providers.
conflicts.reason: Bosco does no hosting itself, so all data, including children's information, resides with third party hosts; the children's section bars giving such information to any third party for any purpose, with no hosting exception.

conflicts.permit: We will collect user's device installed application usage data, and use it to analyze user's social activity.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not track consumers over time and across third party web applications and therefore do not respond to Do Not Track signals.
conflicts.situation: Bosco records which other apps are used on a user's phone over time to analyze the user's social activity.
conflicts.reason: The Do Not Track notice denies tracking across third party applications, while section 4.8 collects usage data of other installed apps; neither statement is limited to exclude the other.
